items.description: Painting disturbed wall area and closing wall opening
items.rationale: Making good the opening after access to the leaking pipe is a repair cost under 7.1.7(a), limited to the affected wall area. Estimate is at the upper end of the customary range for a small patch.
Under 7.1.7(f) the first travel charge per contractor per invoice is indemnified. Amount follows the price prior of about 81.
Consumable installation material is covered under 7.1.7(c). A small amount is expected.
The replacement pipe section for the failed cold water line is covered under 7.1.7(c). This is the first time the item appears on the invoice.
Re-insulating the repaired section is covered under 7.1.7(c) as a layer that formed part of the installation.
Labour of the trade engaged is covered under 7.1.7(g) at customary rates. One hour is reasonable for this repair.
The contractor's own diagnostic and measuring devices are business outlay, not a repair cost, under 7.1.8(b).
Labour is covered under 7.1.7(g). The price prior of about 47 per hour gives roughly 425 for 9 hours.
Under 7.1.7(f) only the first travel charge per contractor invoice is indemnified, so this second charge is not.
Drying needed before the wall was closed and repainted is covered under 7.1.7(b),(e), once per drying operation.
Blades are the contractor's own reusable equipment and are excluded under 7.1.8(b).
Connection fittings used in the pipe repair are covered under 7.1.7(c).
This repeats item 4 on the same invoice. Under 7.1.8(c) a duplicate item of cost is not indemnified.
This duplicates the 1 m insulation already charged in item 5 for the same repaired section. Excluded under 7.1.8(c),(d).
This repeats the identical 9-hour labour charge of item 8. Excluded as a duplicate under 7.1.8(c), and it exceeds the time reasonably required under 7.1.7(g).
